notes.title: Lone Lamp Official Steam Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831542/c2cd1b5db9fa2e3ffa0a672abb6ef69f8eb27950.png[/img]

After 2 years of development, Lone Lamp is now available on Steam. On behalf of the development team, thank you for the support. We hope you enjoy this experience!

Lone Lamp is a 2D point-and-click adventure filled with puzzles. Will you escape or remain [strike]trapped[/strike] here forever?



[url=https://youtu.be/8kAjrXx2cQQ].[/url]
